_about: Shared test cases for the text cleanup (rules.json). Every app runs all of them.
`expected` is the text before the trailing space: the app pastes expected + one space, or nothing when
expected is empty. `words` is the user's word list. `needs_llm` and `phantom` default to false.
Cases named m0-* are real groq-whisper-hint outputs from the M0 benchmark (run m0, opus16).
